question: Should built-in Orgo require an operator-managed workspace and restrict Crabbox cleanup to exact claimed computers, or wait for a safe workspace-delete API?
rationale: The documented cascading delete cannot atomically prove workspace exclusivity, and removing automatic workspace management changes the provider's user-visible contract.

options.title: Use operator-managed workspaces
options.body: Require an explicit workspace and manage only exact claimed computers, never deleting workspaces.

options.title: Defer built-in support
options.body: Wait for a conditional, versioned, or non-cascading workspace deletion primitive.

options.title: Keep integration external
options.body: Leave Orgo to custom tooling until the API contract can support safe built-in lifecycle management.

recommendation.title: Use operator-managed workspaces
recommendation.body: Require an explicit workspace and manage only exact claimed computers, never deleting workspaces.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository member who repeatedly integrated and reviewed this branch and explicitly held merge for provider-specific safety and proof gates.
